verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://git.cafe/mcp that lets AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT read repositories and, with approval, work on issues and pull requests. Read tools cover public repos without an account, connected accounts can be scoped to all or selected repositories, and WebMCP exposes the same tools in browsers that support it. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually connect and use the server successfully.
